headlines.description: — Miguel Amaya hit an RBI single in the eighth inning — only the second hit for Chicago — and four Cubs pitchers combined for a one-hitter in a 1-0 victory over the Cleveland Guardians on Sunday in the opener of a traditional doubleheader.
headlines.shortLinkText: Amaya hits RBI single, Cubs pitchers combine for 1-hitter in 1-0 win over Guardians in DH opener

headlines.description: — Ryan O’Hearn homered and matched a career high with four RBI as the Pittsburgh Pirates beat the Baltimore Orioles 8-2 on Sunday to sweep a three-game series and extend their winning streak to five.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ryan O'Hearn homers and drives in 4 to lift Pirates over Orioles 8-2 for 5th straight win

events.name: Los Angeles Dodgers at Washington Nationals

headlines.description: — Shohei Ohtani homered and hit a go-ahead sacrifice fly, and the Los Angeles Dodgers rallied from a five-run deficit to defeat the Washington Nationals 8-6 and complete a three-game sweep Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ohtani homers, delivers go-ahead sacrifice fly as Dodgers complete sweep of Nationals, 8-6

events.name: Miami Marlins at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Pinch-hitter Graham Pauley had a go-ahead, two-run double in a four-run eighth inning, and the Miami Marlins held off the Yankees 7-6 on Sunday to stop New York's four-game winning streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pauley's go-ahead, 2-run double in 4-run 8th lifts Marlins over Yankees 7-6

events.name: San Diego Padres at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Jackson Merrill had three hits, including a solo homer in the eighth inning that gave the Padres the lead, and San Diego rallied from a four-run deficit on Sunday to beat Boston 8-6 and send the Red Sox to their seventh loss in their last eight games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Machado and Merrill homer for Padres in 8-6 win over flailing Red Sox

events.name: Milwaukee Brewers at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — William Contreras had a double and two RBI and Kyle Harrison struck out six as the Milwaukee Brewers defeated the Kansas City Royals 8-5 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Contreras, Harrison lead Brewers to 8-5 win over Royals

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Minnesota Twins

headlines.description: — Richie Palacios hit a two-run homer in a three-run 10th inning, and the Tampa Bay Rays beat the Minnesota Twins 4-1 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Richie Palacios hits 2-run homer in 10th inning to lift Rays over Twins 4-1

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Davis Martin tossed six innings of four-hit ball to lead the Chicago White Sox past Toronto 3-0 on Sunday for their first three-game sweep of the Blue Jays in 10 years.
headlines.shortLinkText: Davis Martin pitches White Sox past AL champion Blue Jays 3-0 for 3-game sweep

headlines.description: — Elly De La Cruz singled home the winning run in the eighth inning after scoring in the fourth inning with the use of his speed as the Cincinnati Reds beat the Texas Rangers 2-1 on Sunday to sweep the three-game weekend series.
headlines.shortLinkText: De La Cruz leads Reds to 2-1 win over Rangers and series sweep

headlines.description: — Mickey Moniak homered twice and the Colorado Rockies defeated the Philadelphia Phillies 4-1 on Sunday to salvage the finale of a three-game series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mickey Moniak homers twice as Rockies top Phillies 4-1

headlines.description: — Brent Rooker homered twice and had a career-high six RBI, including a three-run shot in the bottom of the 10th inning that gave the Athletics a 12-10 victory over the Houston Astros on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brent Rooker caps huge game with walk-off homer in 10th to give A's a 12-10 win over Astros

events.name: New York Mets at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Pinch-hitter Luis Torrens keyed New York’s four-run eighth inning with a two-run double and the Mets made it three straight wins over the San Francisco Giants with a 5-2 victory Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Torrens' pinch-hit double keys Mets' 4-run 8th as New York knocks off the Giants again, 5-2

events.name: Seattle Mariners at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — Nolan Schanuel drove in automatic runner Adam Frazier with a one-out sacrifice fly in the 11th inning to lift the Los Angeles Angels to an 8-7 walk-off win over the Seattle Mariners on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nolan Schanuel's sacrifice fly lifts Angels to 8-7 win over Mariners in 11 innings

headlines.description: — Ketel Marte doubled on the first pitch of the 10th inning to score automatic runner Jorge Barrosa and the Arizona Diamondbacks beat the Atlanta Braves 6-5 on Sunday to split the four-game series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Diamondbacks beat the Braves 6-5 in 10 innings to split the 4-game series

headlines.description: — CJ Kayfus homered and Gabriel Arias hit an RBI single in the eighth inning as the Cleveland Guardians rallied to beat the Chicago Cubs 6-5 and split a doubleheader Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: CJ Kayfus, Gabriel Arias drive in 2 runs apiece as Guardians down Cubs 6-5 to split doubleheader

events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Detroit Tigers

headlines.description: — Iván Herrera's two-run single capped a four-run fifth inning and the St. Louis Cardinals salvaged the finale of a three-game series with a 5-3 victory over the Detroit Tigers on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Herrera's 2-run single keys 4-run outburst in Cardinals' 5-3 victory over Tigers
